records.question: 最近7天访问量最高的页面 Top 10

records.question: 过去30天没有任何会话活动的用户有多少（流失用户）
agent_sqls:
WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT max(start_time)::date AS max_dt FROM sessions
),
ever AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM sessions WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
),
active_30d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM sessions, anchor
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND start_time >= anchor.max_dt - interval '29 days'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT max_dt FROM anchor) AS anchor_date,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ever) AS ever_active_users,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM active_30d) AS active_last_30d,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM ever) - (SELECT count(*) FROM active_30d) AS churned_users;

records.question: 各获客渠道的用户 ARPU（人均消费）对比，给出最高的3个渠道
agent_sqls:
WITH attr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, channel_id
  FROM user_attributions
  WHERE attribution_type = 'last_touch'
),
rev AS (
  SELECT user_id, SUM(actual_amount) AS spend
  FROM orders
  WHERE status IN ('paid','shipped','delivered')
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT ch.channel_name, ch.channel_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id) AS users,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.spend),0),2) AS total_rev,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.spend),0)/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_id),0),2) AS arpu
FROM attr a
JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = a.channel_id
LEFT JOIN rev r ON r.user_id = a.user_id
GROUP BY ch.channel_name, ch.channel_type
ORDER BY arpu DESC;

records.question: 用户的 30 天复购率是多少
最近7天的 GMV 和再往前7天相比是涨是跌？涨跌多少？
agent_sqls:
WITH anchor AS (SELECT max(dt) AS m FROM mart_daily_kpi)
SELECT
  sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE dt > (SELECT m FROM anchor) - interval '7 day') AS gmv_last7,
  sum(gmv) FILTER (WHERE dt > (SELECT m FROM anchor) - interval '14 day' AND dt <= (SELECT m FROM anchor) - interval '7 day') AS gmv_prev7,
  (SELECT m FROM anchor) AS anchor_dt
FROM mart_daily_kpi

WITH anchor AS (SELECT max(dt) AS m FROM mart_daily_kpi)
SELECT
  sum(CASE WHEN dt > (SELECT m FROM anchor) - interval '7 day' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_last7,
  sum(CASE WHEN dt > (SELECT m FROM anchor) - interval '14 day' AND dt <= (SELECT m FROM anchor) - interval '7 day' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS gmv_prev7,
  (SELECT m FROM anchor) AS anchor_dt
FROM mart_daily_kpi

SELECT dt, gmv FROM mart_daily_kpi
WHERE dt > (SELECT max(dt) FROM mart_daily_kpi) - interval '14 day'
ORDER BY dt
